episodes.title: Kaagaz Ke Phool
episodes.summary: When a set of R&AW officials are asked to create an audit report of Himmat Singh's "miscellaneous" expenses, a nineteen year-old theory finally sees a glimmer of light.

episodes.title: Guide
episodes.summary: The 26/11 terror attack moves the nation and one link leads to the next, guiding Himmat and team closer to the manhunt.

episodes.title: Mughal-E-Azam
episodes.summary: The shipping business tycoon, Hafiz Ali shows the aftermath of a betrayal. The nineteen year-old saga begins to set the stage for a mammoth reveal.

episodes.title: Hum Kisi Se Kam Nahin
episodes.summary: Four assets and four tasks. Himmat's true forces are put to test to see who's worth their mettle and ready to take on the challenging storm coming their way.

episodes.title: Chaudvin Ka Chand
episodes.summary: At last, Farooq's long wait comes to an end and he's face-to-face with Hafiz. Baku is added to the Special Ops map and undiscovered secrets are revealed.

episodes.title: Qurbani
episodes.summary: So close yet so far. Farooq's just a few feet away from the mastermind behind 2001 Parliament attack and yet again it's a touch and go situation for Himmat. Time for a setback. Time for a sacrifice.

episodes.title: Shatranj Ke Khiladi
episodes.summary: Hafiz smells a mole and Himmat finds a pawn. Mind games help Farooq to survive another day.

episodes.title: Sholay
episodes.summary: Showdown! The country is under an imminent attack and time is running out. Finally, Himmat comes face to face with his nemesis.

episodes.title: Friday
episodes.summary: AI scientist Dr Bhargav's abduction from a tech summit and a senior R&AW officer's killing in Delhi push Himmat Singh to realise the beginning of a silent war.

episodes.title: Saturday
episodes.summary: Probing Chaddha and Banerjee, Himmat learns about Shekhawat's mission. Subramanyam pressures Himmat to grab a bank defaulter. Farooq goes to Athens to locate another AI scientist.

episodes.title: Sunday
episodes.summary: Avinash finds a critical lead in Budapest. Himmat learns that the attacks are part of a covert cyber war by China and a larger digital offensive designed to destabilise India.

episodes.title: Monday
episodes.summary: Avinash and Juhi head to Dominica to trace Jignesh Dholakia, who Subramanyam wants arrested at any cost. Meanwhile, Himmat's daughter, Pari, finds long-buried secrets.

episodes.title: Tuesday
episodes.summary: As the web tightens, Himmat suspects a mole within, which leads him to the Collector. Meanwhile, Abbas is tasked with digging into Subramanyam.

episodes.title: Wednesday
episodes.summary: Himmat pieces together the identity of Sudheer Awasthi, who is pulling the strings of the imminent cyber warfare. Later, he finds the mole leaking internal information.

episodes.title: Thursday
episodes.summary: With the clock ticking and the nation hanging by a thread, Himmat and his core squad brace themselves before Sudheer's final phase goes live with the help of Dr Bhargav.
